findings.observed: The N8.10 DR baseline defines generic recovery roles and rollback-versus-restore semantics, but N8.23.B has no current-standard DEV rollback contract binding the exact current/previous known-good Render/Vercel targets from N8.23.A to STOP conditions, forward-fix/restore decision rules, ownership, and evidence responsibilities.
findings.required: Create a DEV-only N8.23 rollback contract with exact targets, deterministic decision tree, STOP conditions, ownership, evidence requirements, and explicit no-Production/no-secret/no-active-DB-destructive guards.
